wayfindingModel.alt: A paper model of a small harbour quay with a sign post of pastel arrow panels pointing different ways, card boats in a paper harbour.

trailMap.alt: A folded paper trail map standing in a zigzag like a mountain range, a dotted path across it and a tiny flag on top.

clayDunes.alt: Sculpted clay dunes in sand and terracotta, lit low from one side, a paper sun on a wire above them.

paperSchool.alt: A paper model of a small school with round windows among paper grass, flowers and a tiny swing.

bankingPhone.alt: A card model of a phone whose screen is blue blocks and a wave-shaped line, clay coins beside it and a paper wave behind.

groceryBags.alt: Small paper grocery bags full of clay carrots, leeks and tomatoes in front of a little card shelf.

parkingPermit.alt: A card parking permit hanging above a small clay car parked in a bay on a paper street map.

typeShapes.alt: Abstract wooden and card shapes like parts of letters, curves and stems standing with generous even space between them.

potteryBooking.alt: Three glazed bowls beside a small card calendar with one day marked, and a tiny model kiln.

purseAndCalendar.alt: A small fabric purse and a few coins beside a card calendar with one week marked in blue.

paperClock.alt: A round paper clock face in pastel segments with card hands and no numbers.

quoteWall.alt: A board of pastel sticky notes in four tidy columns, one colour per column, each note covered in scribbles.

signDetail.alt: A close-up of the sign post's pastel arrow panels, the top one marked with a small anchor.

quayMap.alt: A card map panel on two legs showing the quay from above: blue water, piers and a dotted walking route.

signColours.alt: A fan of colour swatches in sage, powder blue, sand and terracotta, the sign's colours, beside a small arrow cut-out.

arrowSketches.alt: Pencil sketches of arrows and sign shapes on paper, with cut-out arrow trials and a pencil on top.
